lastRequest: Build a fullstack AI Resume Keyword Scanner web application with React, Express, PDF upload parsing, match score calculation, and detailed keyword breakdown.

tasks.title: Database Schema and ORM Setup
tasks.description: Initialize Prisma with postgresql and define User, Resume, JobDescription, and ScanResult models.

tasks.title: Backend API Infrastructure
tasks.description: Implement Express server with JWT auth, Multer for PDF uploads, and OCR/NLP processing services.

tasks.title: NLP Processing Logic
tasks.description: Develop core logic using natural and compromise for resume-to-job keyword matching and semantic scoring.

tasks.title: React Frontend Development
tasks.description: Build UI with Tailwind, React-Query for state, Recharts for dashboard analytics, and jsPDF for export.

tasks.title: System Integration and Validation
tasks.description: Connect frontend flows with backend endpoints, verify JWT authentication, and run end-to-end unit tests.
